cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Explain the missing magician's receipt to the treasurer. You've come a long way since I had to write all your booking emails.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then use the number. You used to wait for me to make every call; ask him for a duplicate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll only send one if the treasurer emails him herself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There, you got a clear answer. Draft her message and get her to send it. Copy yourself in; you're ready to handle the chasing too.
